adjudication_path: Karnataka Stamp Act 1957 s.34 (admission on payment of duty + penalty up to 10× deficiency) / s.39 (Collector) / s.46A

pending_verification.reason: One discretionary [0, 10x] range conflates two materially different statutory routes: s.34 admission in evidence can impose a mandatory 10x penalty (subject to the Rs 5 wording), while the Collector path under s.39 is discretionary up to 10x. Refuse until the output contract represents the selected route explicitly.

source.quoted_text: s.34 (verbatim, official DPAL text): '... the same may ... be admitted in evidence on payment of the duty ... together with a penalty of five rupees, or, when ten times the amount of the proper duty or deficient portion thereof exceeds five rupees, of a sum equal to ten times such duty or portion'. s.39 (Collector): '... if he thinks fit, an amount not exceeding ten times the ...' deficient duty. Modelled as a DISCRETIONARY range up to 10× (PRD §5.6 — never a false point estimate); the s.34 court-admission route is a fixed 10× (documented below).
